name: Shi Heng Yi
reason: Held back for the owner rather than planned: the home page of his temple (shaolintemple.eu, robots.txt read) leads with a statement on an ongoing criminal investigation into abuse at Shaolin Temple Europe in Otterberg, Germany. A former administrator is in pre-trial detention, and the statement rejects online claims that Shi Heng Yi knew about the abuse or allowed it. A web search snippet also says Henan's Shaolin Temple disputes his credentials (unverified forum post). Otherwise listable: base Otterberg, Germany; email info@shaolintemple.eu (temple footer, info@slte.eu on the contact page); his own Podia site shihengyi.online (robots.txt read); the Shaolin.Online 12-month programme; retreats; two YouTube embeds on the temple's video page. The owner should decide whether to list him while the case is open.
